conflicts.title: website-only / Shop / destino externo
conflicts.decision: P0 must not assume a Shop opt-out field or default. The canary is blocked until the executor proves either (a) the exact official v26 field/read mask that forces website-only/no Shop redirection for this Traffic/LPV recipe, or (b) the selected account/creative is not eligible for Shop redirection. Until then the safe contract is: HTTPS external destination URL is operator-declared, no unproven destination_spec field is sent, and any inability to prove no unauthorized Shop redirection blocks create_paused.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Local compile/approve/create must refuse the canary when the website-only/Shop control receipt is missing or stale.
evidence: Astra field registry: docs/specs/meta-completion-v1/META-COMPLETION-SPEC.json PF055 says exact mapping insufficient
Operational code omits destination_type/destination_spec for this P0: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/contrato.py:119-123; backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/compilador.py:125-130

conflicts.title: destination_type em Traffic/LPV
conflicts.decision: For this P0 the payload keeps destination_type omitted on AdSet because the operational code documents that official Traffic destination_type enum does not prove WEBSITE for OUTCOME_TRAFFIC. The canary must treat the first real AdSet create/read-back as the proof point. If Meta refuses the AdSet because destination_type is required or incompatible, the saga records provider refusal, stops the lot, and does not retry with an invented field.
conflicts.runtime_effect: No destination_type default may be injected before an official field is proven. Provider refusal at AdSet is a safe stop, not a reason to synthesize a field.
evidence: Read-back only checks destination_type if it was actually sent: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/executor.py:623-629

conflicts.title: Fable asset supply manifests
conflicts.decision: P0 requires a minimal AssetSupplyManifest subset for every selected static image before compile/approval: asset_ref, slot_key, variation_key, media_type=image, source_kind=PROVIDER_LIBRARY or INTERNAL_ASSET, content_sha256, item_sha256, supply_sha256, width/height when known, mime_type when known, policy_receipt_ref, policy_state in CLEAR or AUTHORIZED, expires_at, lifecycle_state, provider_registration with Meta image_hash/account_ref, and blocked_reasons/unknowns. Nullability follows Fable: unknowns are explicit; width/height >=1 when present; channel_eligibility must include Meta with non-UNKNOWN for P0.
conflicts.runtime_effect: The Meta engine must refuse any asset_ref whose bytes/hash/policy/supply identity receipt is absent, expired, blocked, or not linked exactly to the image_hash that will be sent to Meta.
evidence: Meta image hash is provider identity, not content_sha256: docs/specs/creative-supply-chain-v1/OFFICIAL-API-EVIDENCE.json EV-META-06/EV-META-07

conflicts.title: concorrência e ausência
conflicts.decision: For P0, FOUND+CONGRUENT may close an ambiguous step as created. Absence, incomplete listing, provider unavailability, homonym, missing created_time, or temporal doubt must remain AMBIGUOUS and require manual operator adjudication. resolve-absent must not automatically release a new create/approval after dispatch ambiguity for the first canary.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Before migration/canary, adjust or operationally disable the path that converts AMBIGUOUS to FAILED/absence and the release rule that permits a fresh approval because a prior step is FAILED after ambiguous dispatch.
evidence: Existing code supports ambiguity/no blind retry: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/executor.py:402-423; supabase/migrations/20260904183418_meta_create_paused_executor.sql:582-590
Existing approval live rule excludes FAILED steps: supabase/migrations/20260904183418_meta_create_paused_executor.sql:473-492

conflicts.title: read-back crítico
conflicts.decision: Minimum P0 read-back mask: Campaign id/account_id/name/configured_status/status/effective_status/objective/buying_type/special_ad_categories/is_adset_budget_sharing_enabled; AdSet id/account_id/campaign_id/name/configured_status/status/effective_status/daily_budget/billing_event/optimization_goal/bid_strategy/start_time/targeting/promoted_object/created_time; AdCreative id/account_id/name/status/effective_status/object_story_spec/image_hash/page_id/instagram_actor_id/effective_object_story_id; Ad id/account_id/adset_id/name/configured_status/status/effective_status/creative/created_time. Results are one of CONGRUENT, DIVERGENT, ABSENT, UNKNOWN; raw IDs stay backend-private and receipts expose only opaque refs/has_external_id.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Divergence records readback_error and stops; absence/unknown after dispatch do not trigger retry; Campaign/AdSet/Ad must be PAUSED; Creative is non-veiculable and may be ACTIVE without being described as PAUSED.

conflicts.title: separação de flags
conflicts.decision: Separate flag scopes: META_VALIDATE_ONLY_ENABLED authorizes only remote validate_only; META_CREATE_LEDGER_WRITE_ENABLED authorizes durable validation/approval/step receipts; META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED authorizes dispatch/create only when ledger is also open; reconciliation/read-only lookup must not depend on META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED. Validation receipt must not be gated by the create dispatch flag.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Before migration/canary, ensure durable validate receipt and reconciliation can operate under ledger/read authority without opening dispatch. create_paused still requires META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED and META_CREATE_LEDGER_WRITE_ENABLED simultaneously.
evidence: Current validation receipt is gated by criacao_liberada(): backend/app/routers/trafego_meta_validacao.py:397-415
Current create routes require creation capability before approve/create/reconcile/receipt: backend/app/routers/trafego_meta_criacao.py:377,450,534,643

conflicts.title: Page, Instagram e placements
conflicts.decision: P0 must prove Page ownership/permission and the identity used in object_story_spec. If Instagram identity is not proved, the canary must either use a proven Facebook-only placement subset or block; it must not invent an Instagram actor, allow silent fallback, or rely on automatic placements that can deliver through an unproven identity.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Canary gate requires a fresh opaque Page receipt and either a proven IG actor receipt or a restricted placements receipt. Read-back must compare page and instagram_actor_id when present.
evidence: Operational P0 currently fixes placements_mode AUTOMATIC and blocks manual placements: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/contrato.py:125,162-164
Read-back comments compare Instagram actor if provider returns it: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/executor.py:726-727
Fable policy requires third-party identity gate before paid media: docs/specs/creative-supply-chain-v1/POLICY-AND-PROVENANCE-CONTRACT.json POLICY-01/POLICY-02/POLICY-03

conflicts.title: AdCreative semântica real
conflicts.decision: AdCreative is creatable but not veiculable and has no PAUSED state. The P0 canary authorization must explicitly say it may create a new AdCreative and possibly an unpublished story/creative side-effect, while Campaign, AdSet and Ad are the veiculable objects that must be PAUSED. P0 uses a selected existing static image hash after OCC-01 gate; reuse of an existing AdCreative is not assumed unless the ledger/read-back proves congruent reuse.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Receipts must never say “all objects PAUSED”; they say “all veiculable objects PAUSED” and report Creative as non-veiculable.
evidence: Creative read-back does not require PAUSED: backend/app/trafego/meta_execucao/executor.py:599-606

conflicts.title: peça selecionada / creative supply chain
conflicts.decision: The canary cannot advance until the selected image has a server-read bytes receipt, content_sha256, technical gate, third-party identity/policy gate, CLEAR or AUTHORIZED policy receipt, and exact correspondence between approved bytes, AssetSupplyManifest, supply_sha256 and Meta image_hash. Any unverified third-party logo/identity blocks.
conflicts.runtime_effect: Compile and approve must require policy_receipt_ref/supply_sha256 for every asset_ref. Meta image_hash alone is insufficient.
evidence: Fable OCC-01 blocks static canary: docs/specs/creative-supply-chain-v1/OPEN-CONTRACT-CONFLICTS.json id=OCC-01
